text: Jason's answer stayed with me. He's right that Web of Science and Scopus buried Southern work for decades, but being visible is not the same as being legitimated, and I should say that more carefully. His line between "just metadata" and Indigenous knowledge is too clean. Metadata is exactly where rankings and DOIs do their governing. Geoffrey retracting "services, not data" surprised me, and I welcomed it. Brent calling open a tactic, Nick on openness paying out by compute, and Amy on reading versus training all sharpened my sense that openness is relational. Later I want to warn that the new telemetry schemas and trust signals could become the next compliance regime, and ask who governs them. I also want to push again for federated, community-governed infrastructure, with refusal as a fundable outcome.
